messages:
June: Heads-up, I'm starting a micro-refresh of the Quickstart onboarding flow. Scope: unify env var naming, tighten the 'first deployment' checklist, and add a tiny troubleshooting note for common auth errors. I'll open a draft PR with the updated code snippets.

Ravi: +1. We should also remove the old extras install line and update the macOS notes. Several users hit that last week.

June: Draft PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1104 (WIP). Key changes: REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_KEY, simplified Python snippet, one-line Docker run, and a short PowerShell env var example.

Maya: Can you paste the new Python snippet here so I can verify it runs in CI?

June: Sure, snippet below:
```
from redwood import Client
import os

client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
resp = client.generate("Hello, Redwood!")
print(resp.text)
```

Ravi: Looks good. Add a short note under Troubleshooting: "If you see 401, confirm REDWOOD_KEY is set and has inference scope." That keyword helps support searches.

June: Done in the draft. Also added a small sentence explaining env var differences across shells and an example for PowerShell: `$env:REDWOOD_KEY = "sk-..."`.

ci-bot: docs-lint failed  line-length quickstart.md:53

Maya: I'll run the formatter and push a wrap fix.

Maya: Pushed fix to wrap long commands and removed an outdated link to the legacy auth page.

doc-bot: Preview generated: https://deploy-preview-1104--docs.redwood.com/quickstart-onboard

June: Preview looks fine. @Ravi can you give the deploy checklist a quick read? I condensed steps into three bullets: (1) set key, (2) run local test, (3) deploy container and verify.

Ravi: Reviewed. Tiny nit: change "run local test" -> "run a local smoke test" and add a verification step to curl the health endpoint.

June: Incorporated and force-pushed.

ci-bot: All checks passed  ready to merge.

June: Merged. Created a follow-up issue to add a one-line upgrade note for customers still using REDWOOD_API_KEY and set up a redirect from the old doc.

Maya: Nice. Can we also add a 1-line mention in the release notes for this week? I'll add it to the notes draft.

Ravi: Sounds good  thanks everyone. Closing thread.
